## Next research batches

Plan status: STALE; replan against new client. Editorial research order based on reusable mechanic questions and current coverage gaps, not hero popularity, win rate or certified counter strength.

### 1. Control and channel interactions

Seven, Dynamo, Mo & Krill

First slice reviewed: six conditional channel-interrupt rules; no in-game verification or full-kit coverage.

- Follow up with controlled tests: Knockdown delay vs short channels; protection, removal and Cursed Relic interactions.
- Still open: Static Charge removal, continuous-stun duration reduction, qualifying barrier triggers and personal survival.
- Seven damage markers and Dynamo channel flag are traced to raw properties; alternate tooltip sections and other kit details remain incomplete.

### 2. Healing and persistent damage

Victor, Kelvin, McGinnis

First slice reviewed: healing denial, conditional spirit shielding and separate Inhibitor responses. In-game testing and full-kit coverage remain open.

- Test recipient-specific anti-heal application, Kelvin dome purge/reapplication and buildup timing.
- Resolve turret-trigger attribution, Victor aura toggle interruption and reanimation health separately.
- Extend player delivery coverage beyond the four reviewed heroes without assuming every spirit effect procs identically.

### 3. Flight, movement and escape

Vindicta, Grey Talon, Calico

First slice reviewed: delayed airborne stun/gravity, pre-cast movement denial and Calico melee defense. Targetability, recasts and immunity remain bounded.

- Check movement denial, delivery range and defensive activation windows.
- Distinguish flight, teleport, untargetability and invisibility.
- Review execute wording separately from ordinary bonus damage against low-health targets.

### 4. Remaining roster: typed damage and control

Abrams, Apollo, Baba, Bebop, Billy, Celeste, Deadman Danny, Drifter, Graves, Haze, Holliday, Infernus, Ivy, Lady Geist, Lash, Mina, Mirage, Paige, Paradox, Pocket, Rat King, Rem, Shiv, Silver, Sinclair, Solomon, The Doorman, Venator, Viscous, Vyper, Warden, Wraith, Yamato

Source review pass complete for every captured selectable hero. Partial advice only; no in-game certification.

- Run client tests for the explicit remaining questions in ROSTER_REVIEW.md.
- Extend problem and player-delivery coverage rather than treating one supported scenario as a complete kit.
- Re-review by November 14 UTC; refreshes never renew evidence.

### 5. Second distinct item pass

Apollo, Baba, Billy, Ivy, Lash, Mirage, Paradox, Pocket, Rat King, Rem, Silver, Sinclair, The Doorman, Venator, Vindicta, Viscous, Vyper, Warden, Yamato

Completed source review: 19 formerly one-item heroes each gained one distinct option. All 42 selectable heroes now have at least two; 102 conditional rules across 16 items, no in-game certification.

- Test disable-trigger ordering, passive duration reduction and actionable debuff removal in controlled games.
- Re-run the distinct-item report after changes; investigate any hero below two without adding unsupported counters.
- Extend scenario depth separately: two items across all stages is not two answers to every ability.

## Reusable function queue

Ordered by number of heroes with no current published advice, then total hero reach. This is an editorial research-efficiency order, not a meta or popularity ranking. Heroes with advice can still have major unresearched threats. Response families are investigation directions, not approved item matches.

## Promotion gates

- Repair incomplete ability text and alternate-kit gaps before relying on those profiles.
- Read current item facts and independent matchup evidence for each proposed interaction.
- Record exact affected ability, objective, conditions, exclusions, player scope and patch.
- Add behavioral regressions and keep untested interactions labeled source-reviewed.

Never import this inventory into the recommendation engine. New rules require separate source review and regression checks.
